assets.name: arus-digital-mark
assets.prompt: Logo-brand. Create ONE production mark/icon for Arus Digital, an Indonesian digital business university program website. Square alpha-transparent background. A compact modern emblem featuring a swift cresting digital current and a subtle letter A created by its negative space. Enclose in a near-square rounded navy badge with a clean silhouette, one bold electric lime #C4F52A current shape and one minimal cyan #23B8CF flow accent. Premium editorial visual identity, crisp simplified vector-like edges and optical balance, legible at 24px and 16px, generous clean outside transparent margins of about 7%. Centered. One mark only. No written text, no graduation cap, no university seal, no glow, no gradient, no mockup, no border panels. Navy #071A3D. PNG alpha.
